project_type: Next.js 16 App Router application with Turbopack, TypeScript strict, Tailwind CSS v4
build_system: npm with Next.js build pipeline; Prisma 7 with @prisma/adapter-pg for database; tsx for running scripts
test_framework: vitest with tests in src/lib/__tests__/*.test.ts; node environment; path alias '@' mapped to './src'
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npx prisma generate' to regenerate client after schema changes. 2. Run 'npm run build' to verify Next.js build passes. 3. Run 'npx vitest run' to verify tests pass.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/generated/prisma/ - generated by 'npx prisma generate' from prisma/schema.prisma. Must run after schema changes.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET available. Database is PostgreSQL via Neon (cannot run prisma db push without DB credentials but can validate schema with prisma generate). Use individual creates not createMany (adapter limitation).
contribution_requirements: API routes use try/catch with formatErrorResponse from @/lib/api-error. Import prisma from @/lib/db. UI uses Tailwind CSS v4 classes. Branch should be feat/claims-ledger from main.
key_patterns: API routes: NextRequest/NextResponse, import {prisma} from '@/lib/db', import {formatErrorResponse, generateRequestId, validationError} from '@/lib/api-error'. DB access via lazy Proxy-based prisma singleton. Seed scripts use tsx and direct PrismaClient with PrismaPg adapter (see prisma/seed-demo.ts pattern). UI: 'use client' pages with useState/useEffect/useCallback, Tailwind CSS v4 utility classes, Link from next/link for nav.
directory_structure: src/app/ = Next.js App Router pages and API routes; src/lib/ = shared utilities; src/components/ = React components; src/generated/prisma/ = generated Prisma client; prisma/ = schema and migrations; scripts/ = utility scripts (does not exist yet, needs creation)
